notes: WHERE PHOTOS WERE REALLY TAKEN: 07/08/23/24/25 are all inside the covered passage (the thin strip outline), not on open ground: 24/25 near its east end looking WSW, 07 near the west arch looking WSW, 08 mid-passage looking ENE out of the east arch, 23 at the north wall near the east end. 02-06 are at the lane junction SE of the terrace corner at about (-146..-148, 49..52), looking N/NNW up the lane and ENE along the other lane. 01 is at the mouth of the SSE path about (-153,59.5) looking N across the lane; 21 is on the E-W lane to the west of that; 22 is on the SSE path about 5 m further S than its pin. 09-13 are from the roof eave at about (-172,33) (resection on o1/o2/o4 suggests the pin is 2-3 m too far east; headings look 5-10 deg low). 14-20 are on the roof terrace of the terrace south of the passage; 20 looks down SSE from its south parapet. LANES (all terracotta-tiled): (a) the passage floor is terracotta with small blue-and-white inset tiles and a pebble-mosaic panel, and the same herringbone terracotta continues west as a ~3 m lane on the passage axis to the 36/34 gate - the tan strip there is a public lane, not yards; (b) a ~1.6 m plain terracotta lane with white kerbs runs NNW-SSE along the east face of the two terraces either side of the passage, from the junction near (-146,51) past the east arch to a white arched portal with wrought-iron lantern brackets at the north end, about (-160,28.5), opening onto the pool lawn (not added: could not place the portal within 3 m, and it has no gate leaf visible); (c) a terracotta lane runs ENE-WSW (bearing about 060) roughly 5-6 m south of the south face of the terrace, with that terrace's walled patios (brown doors, bougainvillea, plumbago) on its north side, a ramp, a drain grate and two service covers near (-156,58); (d) a terracotta path leaves (c) at the lamp post and runs SSE along the west face of the bottom-right house, lawn on its west side, towards another pool south of the patch. STREET SIGN: 'CALLE ELENA 18 36' is inside the passage, so Calle Elena is the passage plus the lane west of it; house plaques seen: 'CASA WILKES' (door on north side of passage), 'GEE' (north side), 'HARDING' and another vertical tile plaque on the building north of the west lane. MAP ISSUES: the open tan area east of the passage is not open ground - a white patio wall with brown doors runs parallel to lane (b) about 6-8 m east of the terrace face, and everything east of it is private walled patio belonging to the eastern row; between lane and wall are kerbed beds (clipped low box hedge borders, spider plants, monstera, one newly planted bare bed at the south end) holding the two magnolias. A low single-storey wall with a grilled window closes the north end of that bed near (-151,35). The aerial photo sits about 1.5 m west of the surveyed pool outline in the NW corner, so aerial-derived positions there were shifted east. Existing life ring o6 looks 2-3 m too far SE: in IMG_2204/2205 it is on the fence just beyond pump box o4. The yucca in IMG_2205/2207 appears 2-3 m west of o13.
